headline: Profiles of BYAN's Prospective Directors and Commissioners, Including Hatta Rajasa and Budi Waseso
summary: Bayan Resources is holding an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders to approve changes to its board of directors and commissioners. Candidates reportedly include Hatta Rajasa and Budi Waseso.
why: Bayan Resources is an Indonesian coal producer, and leadership changes can signal shifts in strategy and governance for investors.
original_headline: Sosok Calon Direksi dan Komisaris BYAN, Ada Hatta Rajasa-Budi Waseso
